rows.concrete_observation: Full OrderEffect: harmful effect constructor registers lowest-priority MaxManaCalc listener punish and normal SpellCast listener block. block cancels only Player with HYMN_OF_ORDER; punish setsReserve(1.0F) only same Player/effect condition. fillEffectCures empty, no default-super cure fill. Registry instantiates OrderEffect for hymn_of_order; mod constructor registers registries and ModPotions event class. Full native DeathEvent snapshots active duration to PlayerPersisted.magic_locked=true/magic_lock_duration. Full Clone listener LOW first requires death AND SOULBOUND enchantment holder exists, reads NEW player persistent data, restores effect if keys present then removes keys irrespective addEffect result. It does not copy original player data itself or verify restored effect accepted; shared soulbound inventory restoration is contextual only. Therefore unconditional cross-death lock survival is not proven. Native cached ArsNouveau resolver validates spell/mana first, postEvent builds SpellCastEvent, all onCast/block/entity paths check event not canceled before castType or expendMana. Insufficient mana has its own no-spam message/packet before this event. Silent event refusal itself shown here has no distinct text/sound receipt. SpellUtil.postEvent, event class and MaxMana consumer bodies missing from selected local cache; fixed independent repo commits are not proof of compatible combined binaries or identical event contract. Initial normal gameplay order-effect application not found beyond restore in this cache.
rows.application_to_boss_immune: Separate eligibility failure from mana failure and from later control refusal; a generic casting failure cannot truthfully label Boss immunity. Restoration attempts need acceptance checks before deleting durable reason keys. Player-only cast block must not be described as all-entity control immunity. No interpretation that reserve1 means100percent mana or max mana1 without actual consumer.
rows.semantic_dedup: Support0 until native dispatcher/event/getEntity semantics, max-mana reserve consumer and initial application chain are complete. No credit for callbacks/cure list/persistent-key names/shared wrappers or same cast adapters. Missing bodies cannot be replaced by upstream API assumptions; no guard-ledger transfer. Existing mana-bubble and sonic families not repeated.
rows.limitations: No current effect acquisition proof, actual cross-death persistence, cure engine behavior, client feedback presentation or compatible dependency/runtime verification. Engine PlayerPersisted cloning not re-read. Native spell resolver contextual source from separate fixed commit, never claimed built together. No production, game, compile or tests.
